newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Hainan Expressway plans A, B share offers.
newsitem.headline: China's Hainan Expressway plans A, B share offers.

text.p: Hainan Expressway Co Ltd plans to apply for an offer of 165 million A shares and subsequently 100 million B shares, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The firm, which is building a 5.5 billion-yuan highway in Hainan province in association with a Japanese investment fund, is one of 33 domestic firms recently chosen by the securities authorities as candidates for listing B shares.

If the offers go through, the Haikou-based firm will channel the proceeds into the 250-km highway linking Haikou and Sanya, construction of which started in 1991, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter, China Securites Bulletin.
Hainan Hong Kong & Macao International Trust and Investment Co would underwrite the firm's A shares, but the timing, pricing and listing venue of the offers had yet to be set, he said.
The company had 927.587 million outstanding shares, composed of 563.883 million legal person shares, 259.468 million state shares and 104.236 million staff shares, he said.
The partially operational highway currently carried between 5,000 and 6,000 vehicles a day, he said. He did not give further details.
